gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-gf-pathway-: Pathway Extreme keeps its rounded letters clearly open, beside a big x-height and stubby ascenders. Love Ya Like A Sister is built from rods, not carved blades, so text beneath it moves along smoothly, line after line.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-gf-prompt: Approachable from the first glance, Prompt has oversized small letters and apertures you can read straight through. But Love Ya Like A Sister has crossbars matching its stems, and text beneath glides along without fuss.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-gf-puritan: Single-gauge strokes define Love Ya Like A Sister, its ascenders barely clearing the x-height. Puritan has rounded forms open to the side and generous counters in e and a, so a modest size is plenty.
gen-eater-gf-noto-sans-sundanese: Dark and aggressive, Eater spaces its letters far apart. Eater is best at thin strokes against weightier stems, while Noto Sans Sundanese does clean, quiet text with open-mouthed e crossbars.
gen-flavors-gf-noto-sans-syriac-western: Whimsical, towering Flavors has an x-height like a carpenter's pencil. Noto Sans Syriac Western holds its terminals far from the stroke body, and that openness against the sturdy Flavors is the whole charm.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-stack-sans-text: Stack Sans Text draws a marker-like constant line. Gugi does its best work in tall lowercase that nearly reaches the capitals, whereas the body text handles big-bodied letters with curve endings kept apart.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-anek-tamil: Wide-margined and commanding, Metamorphous holds its midline high. Anek Tamil brings big round lowercase bowls, and set against the heading's soft fat-and-slim shift, that modern roundness is what stands out.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-anuphan: Anuphan reads cleanly, with big round lowercase bowls and open curves that leave clear gaps between strokes. Nudge Anuphan up in size and Metamorphous keeps its gentle thickening and thinning.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-athiti: Wide margins, a high midline, and a commanding stance. Athiti is at its best with its constant line width and see-through s, whereas Metamorphous is best at commanding, softly shaded display letters.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-carrois-gothic-sc: Commanding and distinctive, Metamorphous spaces its letters generously and varies its a gently from fat to slim strokes. Carrois Gothic SC then keeps the text below open and level in height.
